editorial.blurb: A warmly run family restaurant where Arnold and his dad welcome you like family, serving fresh, carefully crafted Chinese food with genuine care.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for lunch or dinner and ask about the Mongolian beef—reviewers say it's exceptional, and the brown sauce is so good you could eat it on its own.

topDishes.note: silly delicious with an amazing brown sauce, perhaps the best around
crispy with a nice crunch, filled with fresh ingredients
